study.name: Digital Days
study.project: Years and moments: Youth wellbeing across changing digital worlds

wearable.api_notes: Legacy Fitbit Web API support ended 30 Sep 2026 and its endpoints are switched off on 2 Nov 2026 (developers.google.com/health). v4 data types used: sleep (list), steps (dailyRollUp), heart-rate (60 s rollUp -> wear minutes). Heart rate is stored at 1 s and steps at 1 min resolution, so minute-level wear time is available.
wearable.pull_cadence: daily during a burst (catch sync gaps early); final pull at burst day 15

steps: Go to https://accountscenter.instagram.com/info_and_permissions/
Click 'Export your information', then 'Create export'
Select the account you want to export (if you have more than one)
Choose 'Export to device'
Set: Customise information -> 'All available information'; Date range -> 'All time'; Format -> 'JSON'; Media quality -> 'Lower quality'
Click 'Start export'
instagram.portal_reads: your_instagram_activity/**/*.json - timestamps of likes, comments, saved posts, posts viewed (no media, no message text)
instagram.source: AIO instructions supplied by the project team (Oct 2026)

steps: In the TikTok app go to Profile -> Menu (top right) -> Settings and privacy -> Account -> 'Download your data'
Choose the data to include ('All data' is fine) and select the file format 'JSON'
Tap 'Request data'. Preparing the file can take a few days; TikTok notifies you when it is ready
Download it from the same screen (the file is available for about four days)
tiktok.portal_reads: Watch History -> VideoList dates only (video links are dropped)
tiktok.source: TechCrunch, 17 Jan 2025; TikTok support page above (verify)

steps: Go to https://takeout.google.com/ and sign in with the Google account you use for YouTube
Click 'Deselect all', then tick 'YouTube and YouTube Music'
Click 'All YouTube data included', untick everything except 'history', click OK
Click 'Multiple formats' and set History to 'JSON'
Click 'Next step', keep 'Send download link via email', file type '.zip', then 'Create export'
Download from the email link (valid about 7 days)
youtube.portal_reads: watch-history.json times only (titles and links are dropped)
youtube.note: If the channel belongs to a Brand Account, switch to it before exporting.
youtube.source: takeoutday.org guide (third party; verify against support.google.com)

steps: Sign in at https://chatgpt.com on a computer or phone browser
Open Settings -> 'Data controls' -> 'Export data' -> 'Confirm export'
You will receive an email; click 'Download data export' within 24 hours to get a .zip file
chatgpt.format: zip with chat.html and conversations.json (the parser uses conversations.json)
chatgpt.portal_reads: conversations.json - your messages (text + time) and the time/length of each AI reply; AI reply text is dropped
chatgpt.source: OpenAI Help Center article 7260999 (page dated 2023; verify current menu)

steps: Sign in at https://claude.ai (web or Claude Desktop; not available in the mobile apps)
Go to Settings -> Privacy and click 'Export data'
You will receive an email with a download link; open it within 24 hours while signed in
claude.portal_reads: conversations.json - your messages (text + time) and the time/length of each AI reply; AI reply text is dropped
claude.note: Team/Enterprise accounts can export only if the organisation owner allows it.

consent_screen: You can look through your file and remove anything before you share it.
From AI chats we keep only what YOU wrote, plus the time of each message; the AI's replies are reduced to length and time.
We do not read your files in real time. You can withdraw your donation at any time before analysis.

steps: Open the donation page from the link in your burst-end SMS/email and enter your study code (e.g., DD1A2B3C4D)
Choose the platform and select the .zip (or .json) file you downloaded - it is opened on your device, not uploaded
Review the summary and the table of what will be shared; untick any conversation or day you want to remove
Press 'Download donation file', then upload that file at the secure RMIT link shown on the page
direct_portal.upload_target: TO-BE-CONFIGURED: RMIT secure upload (e.g., REDCap file-upload field keyed to the study code, or a SharePoint/OneDrive file request). Must be approved by ethics before use.
